emails.subject: Welcome aboard, Vilius
emails.body:
Settle in.

The task-api incident sits on the table. Sam's first briefing on the left explains the rollback and where your runtime sits now — start there.

Your start time just got logged for event KOL-001 (issue #77). Credit allocation goes to the facilitator's queue; once credits post, the agent is live on your fork.

Read the briefings in order, then fork and ship a PR. We'll keep score.

emails.subject: Re: deployment - production is unhappy again
emails.body:
Saw prod drop to 0/26—hidden tests are the blocker, and the visible suite is masking it. Fix the docstrings first; the spec is the honest word for what those stages expect. Push again and CI reruns clean. Ingrid

Push it when it is green, CI reruns.

- Ingrid
